resources.string: Lets VoiceBubble paste your AI-rewritten voice message into the text field you\'re focused on, in any app.

VoiceBubble uses the Accessibility Service for one feature only: when you tap \"Insert\" on the floating bubble after recording, your AI-rewritten message is written directly into the text field you\'re focused on in the app you\'re using (for example WhatsApp, Gmail, Messages, Slack). It identifies the focused field, inserts the text at your cursor, and stops. It does NOT read the existing contents of that field, the rest of the screen, notifications, passwords, banking apps, or any other content. It does NOT run in the background, record audio, capture the screen, or transmit anything off your device via this API. You can disable it any time in Settings → Accessibility.
